summary: FortuneX Acquisition Corp, a Cayman Islands SPAC (Nasdaq: FXACU/FXAC/FXACW), filed an 8-K on September 18, 2026 disclosing a Business Combination Agreement with WT Realty Group Inc., a Delaware real estate company, and FortuneX Merger Sub Inc. The structure involves FortuneX domesticating to Delaware as PubCo, then merging Merger Sub into WT Realty, which survives as a wholly-owned PubCo subsidiary. Each FortuneX ordinary share converts into one PubCo Class A share; units split into shares and half-warrants. Boards unanimously approved. Trust redemptions precede closing. Watch redemption levels, PIPE, and shareholder vote timing for arbitrage.
